items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: They called me 'Babe Ruth' around there during that time, you know. Then it became 'Baby Ruth' and 'Baby Ray'...

ctx.x: Oh, they'd give you three or four dollars or something like that, you know. And that bought me the name in a hurry around my home, you know. And I have to unveil something that I don't unveil too often, that I had a nickname around home. They called me "Babe Ruth" around there during that time, you know. Then it became "Baby Ruth" and "Baby Ray"... You know, they went through all the babies as I came along, you know.
Did it have anything to do with baseball, or just ...(? )...
